[{"type":"text","text":"<path>D:\repository\skills-wt-ov-snapshot-fix\scripts\run-openviking-snapshots.ps1</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>
1: param(
2:   [switch]$Push,
3:   [string]$Reason = "scheduled"
4: )
5: 
6: # Keep ASCII only: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less UTF-8 as ANSI.
7: $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
8: $SkillsRoot = if ($PSScriptRoot) { Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent } else { "D:\repository\skills" }
9: $Node = (Get-Command node -ErrorAction Stop).Source
10: $DataScript = Join-Path $SkillsRoot "scripts\snapshot-openviking-data.mjs"
11: $MemScript = Join-Path $SkillsRoot "scripts\snapshot-openviking-memory.mjs"
12: $OvServer = "C:\Program Files\Python310\Scripts\openviking-server.exe"
13: $OvConf = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".openviking\ov.conf"
14: $LogDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP "openviking-snapshot"
15: $LogFile = Join-Path $LogDir "$(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd-HHmmss).log"
16: 
17: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $LogDir -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
18: 
19: function Write-Log([string]$msg) {
20:   $line = "$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') $msg"
21:   Add-Content -Path $LogFile -Value $line -Encoding UTF8
22:   Write-Host $line
23: }
24: 
25: function Stop-OpenVikingIfRunning {
26:   $p = Get-Process -Name "openviking-server" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
27:   if (-not $p) { return $false }
28:   Write-Log "Stopping openviking-server (pid $($p.Id)) for vectordb snapshot"
29:   Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force
30:   Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
31:   return $true
32: }
33: 
34: function Start-OpenVikingIfDown {
35:   $listening = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":1933 " | Select-String "LISTENING"
36:   if ($listening) { return }
37:   if (-not (Test-Path $OvServer)) {
38:     Write-Log "WARN: OV server exe missing, skip start"
39:     return
40:   }
41:   Write-Log "Starting openviking-server"
42:   Start-Process -FilePath $OvServer -ArgumentList "--config", $OvConf -WindowStyle Minimized
43:   Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
44: }
45: 
46: # PS 5.1 turns native stderr piped via 2>&1 into ErrorRecord and aborts under Stop.
47: # Redirect all streams to a file (no pipeline), then log the lines and check exit code.
48: function Invoke-Snapshot([string]$scriptPath, [string]$tag, [string[]]$argv) {
49:   $tmp = Join-Path $LogDir "$tag.out"
50:   Write-Log "RUN: $scriptPath $($argv -join ' ')"
51:   & $Node $scriptPath @argv *> $tmp
52:   $code = $LASTEXITCODE
53:   if (Test-Path $tmp) {
54:     foreach ($l in (Get-Content $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Log ([string]$l) }
55:     Remove-Item $tmp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
56:   }
57:   Write-Log "EXIT: $code"
58:   return $code
59: }
60: 
61: $commitArgs = @("--commit", "--reason", $Reason)
62: if ($Push) { $commitArgs += "--push" }
63: 
64: $wasRunning = Stop-OpenVikingIfRunning
65: try {
66:   Write-Log "=== snapshot-openviking-data.mjs ==="
67:   $c1 = Invoke-Snapshot $DataScript "data" $commitArgs
68:   if ($c1 -ne 0) { throw "snapshot-openviking-data failed exit $c1" }
69: 
70:   Write-Log "=== snapshot-openviking-memory.mjs ==="
71:   $c2 = Invoke-Snapshot $MemScript "memory" $commitArgs
72:   if ($c2 -ne 0) { throw "snapshot-openviking-memory failed exit $c2" }
73: 
74:   Write-Log "DONE"
75: } catch {
76:   Write-Log "FAILED: $($_.Exception.Message)"
77:   throw
78: } finally {
79:   if ($wasRunning) { Start-OpenVikingIfDown }
80: }
